recommendation_title: Prioritize Playback Reliability Over Other Areas
recommendation: Playback should be the top priority this quarter: the single playback complaint carries the highest mean severity of 4.000000 [C007] and priority score of 4 [C008], and it is tied to explicit cancellation intent in `a7b7539a-c8d3-4f4e-9edd-d46cd1b1fd12`, where the user says playback stopped immediately after subscribing to Premium. Billing/support follows closely with a severity sum of 3 [C010], driven by a Premium upsell blocking app usage [ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS]. While general dissatisfaction (ISS-OTHER-GENERAL) has the most complaints at 3 [C001], its mean severity is only 2.000000 [C003], and these reviews lack specific, actionable detail beyond expressions of dislike.
